Crafted Where Mountain Mist Meets Pure Spring Waters

The Knuckles Mountain Range is renowned for its crisp microclimates and heavy morning dew. Tea bushes grown on these steep terrain contours produce leaves with extraordinary polyphenol depth, yielding the rich color and fragrant punch distinctive to genuine Wattegama teas.
